<div class="card-body">
'''Logistical Delay''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">遅延連鎖</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">3フォース使用して場の相手の側に配備する。相手のタイはすべて配備コスト＋1となる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Logistical-Delay-SWCA-67686.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">皇帝の強大な殺人兵器は、あらゆる段階で微妙な調整を必要としている。どこかの行程で思わぬ手違いが起これば、配備計画全体が大幅に遅れる事態を招きかねない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Logistical Delay.

'''Card text:'''
Use 3 Force to deploy on the opponent's side of the table. All of the opponent's TIEs are deploy cost +1.

'''Lore:'''
The Emperor's mighty killing weapon needs fine adjustment at every stage. An unexpected slip in any step can greatly delay the whole deployment plan.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 遅延連鎖 (delay chain).
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Logistical Delay]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
